strings.name: Lupita Nyong’o
strings.summary: Born in Mexico and raised in Kenya, Nyong’o entered international cinema after film and drama training. Her Oscar-winning work in 12 Years a Slave led to Black Panther, Us and animated voice roles. Her picture book Sulwe addresses colorism and self-worth for children, connecting creativity with African women’s public expression.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Her acting and writing, beginning with 12 Years a Slave, broaden public expression around African women and skin-color identity.
